<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political protests:</strong> Karnataka BJP leaders, including B.Y. Vijayendra and B.S. Yediyurappa, staged a protest in Bengaluru against recent hikes in bus fares and milk prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Public administration:</strong> Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has urged IPS probationers to prioritize building public trust through effective and transparent policing.</li>
</ul>
